First release of the standalone Rust backend for Sub-Store.

## New Features

- Run the backend without Node.js. Rust handles HTTP, storage, subscription and rule conversion, built-in processors, scheduling, backup and synchronization.
- Use the official Sub-Store frontend without source changes. The included frontend is pinned to `4bd7b0acbe65466b933ccea14fc61dbebe036ead`.
- Run general JavaScript scripts through the embedded QuickJS engine, including the supported storage, network and conversion helpers.
- Download native Linux x64/arm64 and Windows x64 packages, Docker image archives for both Linux architectures, and the unchanged frontend bundle.

## Compatibility

- Existing JSON data files and frontend API conventions are retained. Back up your data before migrating, and run only one backend against a writable data directory.
- Node.js built-ins, `require`/npm package loading, `process.env`, `$substore.node` and native addons are excluded. Choose a script's general JavaScript variant when available.
- Native Linux binaries require glibc 2.38 or newer. Use the Docker image archive when the host libraries do not meet the native package requirements.

## Downloads

Each package includes source provenance, file hashes and license notices. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS`; matching `.manifest.json` files identify the exact source and build target.

Docker packages contain a saved image for `docker load`. Installation, frontend hosting, configuration and rollback instructions are in the packaged README or [rust/README.md](https://github.com/DSLZL/Sub-Store/blob/v0.0.1/rust/README.md).
